description: Shared categorisation base for every Skio analysis catalogued. Every metric, dimension, chart, insight and recommendation is tagged with exactly one domain. Domains mirror the Skio analytics sections (overview, cancel_flow, cohort, dunning, products, segments, forecast) plus the lenses the reports add on top (cadence, offers, engagement, events, method).

domains.name: Subscriber base & growth
domains.question: How big is the base and how is it moving?

subdomains.stock: Point-in-time counts of active subscriptions and subscribers
subdomains.flow: New, cancelled, reactivated and net change over a window
subdomains.adjust: Adjustments that separate organic movement from administrative events

domains.name: Revenue & order economics
domains.question: How much money does the programme make and from which order types?

subdomains.mix: Split between first-time, recurring and one-time revenue
subdomains.unit: Per-order and per-day economics such as AOV

domains.name: Cancel flow & saves
domains.question: When people try to leave, how many are kept and with what?

subdomains.value: Monthly recurring revenue at risk, saved and lost

domains.name: Retention & lifetime value
domains.question: How long do subscribers stay and what are they worth?

subdomains.curve: Retention measured from each subscriber's own start
subdomains.survival: Share still active or already cancelled
subdomains.timing: When cancellations happen after an event

domains.name: Payments & dunning
domains.question: How much failed-payment churn is recovered?

subdomains.outcome: Recovered, lost and open dunning cases
subdomains.prevention: Safeguards such as backup payment methods

domains.name: Products & merchandising
domains.question: Which products, variants and categories carry the programme?

domains.name: Cadence & plans
domains.question: Which delivery intervals do people pick, keep and retain on?

domains.name: Offers & discounts
domains.question: Which discounts attract subscribers who stay?

subdomains.cohort: Results by discount code or offer structure
subdomains.attribution: Which offers drive new subscriptions now

domains.name: Engagement & self-service
domains.question: Do subscribers manage their subscription instead of cancelling?

domains.name: Events & seasonality
domains.question: What happens around launches and peak sales periods?

domains.name: Forecasting
domains.question: What is queued and projected for upcoming periods?

domains.name: Method & data quality
domains.question: How were the numbers built and can they be trusted?

grains.subscription: One subscription contract. A customer can hold several.
grains.subscriber: One customer with at least one subscription.
grains.subscription_line: One product line inside a subscription. Category and pack analyses often use this grain.
grains.session: One cancel-flow session. A subscriber can open several.
grains.dunning_window: One period a subscription spends in failed-payment retry.

entity_kinds.metric: A number with a canonical definition in metric_registry.json
entity_kinds.concept: An analysis method, definition choice or caveat in concept_registry.json
entity_kinds.chart: A visual encoding described against chart_patterns.json
entity_kinds.ui: A report anatomy element in chart_patterns.json under ui_patterns
entity_kinds.insight: A claim the report makes, typed as finding, risk, opportunity or watch
entity_kinds.recommendation: An action the report proposes, tagged with the lever domain it pulls
entity_kinds.qa_flag: A problem found while reverse-engineering the report

insight_types.risk: A result that threatens a KPI
insight_types.watch: A trend to monitor before acting

qa_severity.high: Changes the conclusion or makes a headline number unreliable
qa_severity.medium: Makes a number hard to reproduce or compare

qa_types.internal_inconsistency: Two numbers in the same report disagree
qa_types.arithmetic: A stated figure cannot be reproduced from its own inputs
qa_types.definition: A metric is defined differently from the canonical or from other reports
qa_types.method: A bias or construction problem in the analysis
qa_types.unsourced_claim: A benchmark or causal claim with no evidence shown
qa_types.labelling: A label, count or name is wrong

report_archetypes.name: Cancel-flow deep dive
report_archetypes.description: Question-led analysis of one domain with a recommended-actions list.

report_archetypes.name: Animated narrative replay
report_archetypes.description: A single month replayed as motion for impact, with totals on an end card.

report_archetypes.name: Launch one-pager
report_archetypes.description: Print-ready snapshot of a short launch window with product spotlights.

report_archetypes.name: Quarterly account review
report_archetypes.description: Multi-tab quarter-over-quarter review with patterns, method notes and matched windows.

report_archetypes.name: Trailing-30 pulse with deep dives
report_archetypes.description: Ten-KPI pulse with weekly trend tiles, meeting topics and topic tabs.

report_archetypes.name: Strategic insight report
report_archetypes.description: Quarter review with a ranked priorities roadmap, issued in corrected versions.

report_archetypes.name: Workbook scope sheet
report_archetypes.description: Cover sheet of an analysis workbook: data source, definitions, headline counts, caveats.

report_archetypes.name: Cancel-flow audit build doc
report_archetypes.description: Action list with effort and build location, backed by flow data.
